views.name: chat_points_ranking
views.definition:
SELECT p.user_id,
    p.nickname,
    COALESCE(sum(l.points_delta), 0::bigint) AS points,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(sum(l.points_delta), 0::bigint) >= 500 THEN 'Diamante'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(sum(l.points_delta), 0::bigint) >= 250 THEN 'Oro'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(sum(l.points_delta), 0::bigint) >= 100 THEN 'Plata'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(sum(l.points_delta), 0::bigint) >= 25 THEN 'Bronce'::text
            ELSE 'Principiante'::text
        END AS medal
   FROM chat_profiles p
     LEFT JOIN chat_points_ledger l ON l.user_id = p.user_id
  GROUP BY p.user_id, p.nickname;

views.name: chat_public_profile_badges
views.definition:
SELECT p.user_id,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM chat_vip_members v
          WHERE v.user_id = p.user_id)) AS is_vip,
    COALESCE(sum(l.points_delta), 0::bigint) AS points,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(sum(l.points_delta), 0::bigint) >= 500 THEN 'Diamante'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(sum(l.points_delta), 0::bigint) >= 250 THEN 'Oro'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(sum(l.points_delta), 0::bigint) >= 100 THEN 'Plata'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(sum(l.points_delta), 0::bigint) >= 25 THEN 'Bronce'::text
            ELSE 'Principiante'::text
        END AS medal
   FROM chat_profiles p
     LEFT JOIN chat_points_ledger l ON l.user_id = p.user_id
  GROUP BY p.user_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_bans(pin_input text)
 RETURNS TABLE(sender_id text, nickname text, ban_type text, room_id bigint, client_ip inet, expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT public.verify_admin_pin(pin_input) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PIN incorrecto';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY

    SELECT
        b.sender_id,
        b.nickname,
        'Todas las salas'::text,
        NULL::bigint,
        u.client_ip,
        b.expires_at
    FROM public.wichat_bans b
    LEFT JOIN public.wichat_user_ips u
        ON u.sender_id = b.sender_id
    WHERE b.expires_at IS NULL OR b.expires_at > now()

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.sender_id,
        b.nickname,
        'Sala específica'::text,
        b.room_id,
        u.client_ip,
        b.expires_at
    FROM public.wichat_room_bans b
    LEFT JOIN public.wichat_user_ips u
        ON u.sender_id = b.sender_id
    WHERE b.expires_at > now()

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        u.sender_id,
        b.nickname,
        'Baneo por IP'::text,
        b.room_id,
        b.client_ip,
        b.expires_at
    FROM public.wichat_ip_bans b
    LEFT JOIN public.wichat_user_ips u
        ON u.client_ip = b.client_ip
    WHERE b.expires_at > now();
END;
$function$

functions.name: admin_moderate_user
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_moderate_user(action_name text, pin_input text, room_id_input bigint, target_sender_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    target_nickname text;
    expiry timestamptz;
    selected_action text;
    target_ip inet;
BEGIN
    -- Verificar PIN del administrador
    IF NOT public.verify_admin_pin(pin_input) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PIN incorrecto';
    END IF;

    -- Proteger a todos los administradores activos
    IF public.is_wichat_admin(target_sender_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'No se puede expulsar ni banear a un administrador';
    END IF;

    IF target_sender_id IS NULL OR trim(target_sender_id) = '' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Usuario no válido';
    END IF;

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.rooms
        WHERE id = room_id_input
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'La sala no existe';
    END IF;

    selected_action := lower(action_name);

    IF selected_action NOT IN ('kick', 'ban') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acción no válida';
    END IF;

    SELECT nickname
    INTO target_nickname
    FROM public.messages
    WHERE sender_id = target_sender_id
      AND room_id = room_id_input
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    target_nickname := COALESCE(target_nickname, 'Usuario');

    expiry := now() + interval '5 minutes';

    IF selected_action = 'kick' THEN

        DELETE FROM public.wichat_kicks
        WHERE sender_id = target_sender_id
          AND room_id = room_id_input;

        DELETE FROM public.wichat_room_bans
        WHERE sender_id = target_sender_id
          AND room_id = room_id_input;

        INSERT INTO public.wichat_room_bans
            (sender_id, room_id, nickname, reason, created_at, expires_at)
        VALUES (
            target_sender_id,
            room_id_input,
            target_nickname,
            'Expulsión de cinco minutos',
            now(),
            expiry
        );

    ELSE

        SELECT client_ip
        INTO target_ip
        FROM public.wichat_user_ips
        WHERE sender_id = target_sender_id;

        DELETE FROM public.wichat_kicks
        WHERE sender_id = target_sender_id;

        INSERT INTO public.wichat_bans
            (sender_id, nickname, reason, expires_at)
        VALUES (
            target_sender_id,
            target_nickname,
            'Baneo de cinco minutos',
            expiry
        )
        ON CONFLICT (sender_id)
        DO UPDATE SET
            nickname = EXCLUDED.nickname,
            reason = EXCLUDED.reason,
            created_at = now(),
            expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at;

        DELETE FROM public.wichat_room_bans
        WHERE sender_id = target_sender_id;

        IF target_ip IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO public.wichat_ip_bans
                (client_ip, room_id, nickname, reason, expires_at)
            VALUES (
                target_ip,
                room_id_input,
                target_nickname,
                'Baneo por IP de cinco minutos',
                expiry
            )
            ON CONFLICT (client_ip, room_id)
            DO UPDATE SET
                nickname = EXCLUDED.nickname,
                reason = EXCLUDED.reason,
                created_at = now(),
                expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at;
        END IF;

    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.wichat_moderation_events
        (sender_id, room_id, action)
    VALUES (
        target_sender_id,
        room_id_input,
        selected_action
    );

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'action', selected_action,
        'ip_banned', CASE
            WHEN selected_action = 'ban'
            THEN target_ip IS NOT NULL
            ELSE false
        END,
        'expires_at', expiry,
        'message', CASE
            WHEN selected_action = 'ban'
            THEN 'Estás baneado por cinco minutos'
            ELSE 'Has sido expulsado por cinco minutos'
        END
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_chat_room_polls(room_id_input bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'id',p.id,'room_id',p.room_id,'question',p.question,'options',p.options,
  'is_closed',p.is_closed,'created_at',p.created_at,'updated_at',p.updated_at,
  'votes',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(coalesce(v.cnt,0) order by opt.ord) from jsonb_array_elements_text(p.options) with ordinality opt(val,ord)
   left join (select option_index,count(*)::int cnt from public.chat_room_poll_votes where poll_id=p.id group by option_index) v on v.option_index=opt.ord-1),'[]'::jsonb),
  'total_votes',(select count(*) from public.chat_room_poll_votes where poll_id=p.id),
  'my_vote',(select option_index from public.chat_room_poll_votes where poll_id=p.id and user_id=auth.uid() limit 1)
 ) order by p.created_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
 from public.chat_room_polls p where p.room_id=room_id_input
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.wichat_normalize_moderation_text(txt text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
 select trim(regexp_replace(
   regexp_replace(
     translate(lower(coalesce(txt,'')), 'áéíóúüñ013457@$',
                                      'aeiouunoieastas'),
     '([a-z])\1+', '\1', 'g'
   ),
   '[^a-z0-9]+',' ','g'
 ));
$function$
